description: Cloud-scale monitoring, security, and observability platform for infrastructure, application performance, logs, and metrics.
auth_notes: Authenticate via API key (DD-API-KEY header) for writing/reporting data, and an application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY header) for reading data.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial or free tier account self-serve and generate API and application keys directly inside the platform dashboard.
api_notes: Extensive REST API covering dashboards, monitors, metrics, logs, APM, security, service level objectives, and user management, supported by official client libraries.
mcp_notes: Datadog explicitly lists an official MCP Server in their documentation and platform capabilities.
rationale: Datadog provides an extensive, well-documented REST API with self-serve free trial account access and official client libraries, making it immediately ready for integration into agent toolkits.

evidence.note: Describes DD-API-KEY and DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers required for API authentication.
Shows getting started documentation and availability of free trial/getting started accounts.
Details the comprehensive REST API structure and official client libraries.
Lists MCP Server as an official offering under AI / Extensibility platform capabilities.
